meta.title: CRYPTO NOVA AI: the AI engine for the crypto market
meta.desc: An app with an AI system that scans the crypto market every minute and tests hundreds of strategies every night. See every trade with its entry, stop and reason, follow the public portfolio, learn in 56 lessons and ask NOVA.
hero.sub: CRYPTO NOVA AI never stops: it watches the market, checks millions of data points of history, filters out the weak and keeps only what passed the test. In the app you see every trade with its entry, stop and reason, learn in 56 short lessons and ask NOVA anything, by text or voice.
hero.note: No subscriptions. We never hold your money.

sys.lead: Five stages that run without a break. The numbers on this page come live from the system.
sys.s1.p: Every night the lab writes hundreds of trading rules and tests them on years of history across {m} markets, fees included. Almost all of them fail, and that is the point: only what survives goes further.
f.note: The exam: the rule is tuned on past years and judged only on later years it has never seen. The luck test: it must beat the best of as many random rules.
sys.s2.p: A rule that passes the exam trades on a demo account at real prices. To pass all gates it needs enough trades and days, profit after fees and a drawdown no deeper than in testing. A strategy that stops working is retired automatically.
sys.s3.p: Once a minute, before any new entry, six limits are checked across all accounts. A day at −3% pauses new trades until midnight UTC; a −15% drawdown from the peak stops everything. Closing a trade by its stop or target is never blocked.
sys.s4.p: Every forecast is written down before the outcome is known and checked afterwards. Each line is chained to the previous one with a SHA-256 hash, so the past can't be quietly edited. Sources that lose are shown too.
v.worse_than_coin: worse than a coin flip so far
sys.s5.p: You see every trade: the coin, the direction, entry, stop, target and why the system entered. Whether to repeat it on your own exchange account is your decision. There is no automated trading.

start.s1.p: Download it on iPhone or iPad. No subscriptions or purchases inside.
start.s2.p: Follow the public portfolio, open your own demo account with any amount and take the lessons. There is nothing to lose: the money is virtual.
start.s3.t: Go real, if you want to
start.s3.p: Open an account on the partner exchange BingX through the link in the app, fund it and enter your UID. You repeat the trades yourself, and the money stays in your exchange account.
start.money.p: If you open an exchange account through our link, the exchange pays CRYPTO NOVA part of its own fee. Your fees and terms stay the same. That is how we earn, so you pay no subscription.
start.risk: Exchanges are not available in every country: don't open an account where the law doesn't allow it. Crypto trading is high risk, and you can lose all the money you put in.
faq.q1: How much does the app cost?
faq.a1: Demo accounts, the Piggy bank, 56 lessons and NOVA come with no subscriptions or purchases inside the app. NOVA answers 5 questions a day, or 100 a day with a connected real account.
faq.q2: How does CRYPTO NOVA make money?
faq.a2: Through the exchange's partner program. If you open a BingX account through our link, the exchange pays us part of its own fee. Your fees don't change, and we take no share of your profit.
faq.q3: Does the app trade for me?
faq.a3: No. There is no automated trading. You see every trade of the system and decide yourself whether to repeat it on your own exchange account.
faq.a4: In demo there is no real money. If you trade for real, the money stays in your own exchange account: we can't see, move or withdraw it. We never ask for passwords, SMS codes, seed phrases or exchange keys.
faq.a5: The public portfolio is a demo account: virtual money at real prices, running since {since}. Tests on history are not a promise about the future. Losing trades and losing forecasts are published next to the winners.
faq.a6: No. CRYPTO NOVA is education and demo accounts. The decisions are yours, and crypto trading is high risk.
faq.a7: The app is operated by Dmytro Sukhyna. Write to cryptonova.app@gmail.com or to @crypto_nova_support on Telegram.
faq.q8: I have an old Pro or VIP subscription
faq.a8: Version 2.0 doesn't need it. Cancel it in iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions, or in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.
final.p: Available on iPhone and iPad. The engines are already running.
foot.about: Education and demo accounts. CRYPTO NOVA is not an exchange, broker or financial adviser and never holds your money. Crypto trading is high risk.

eng.lead: Inside the app works a whole system. Each engine does one job and passes its result on. Tap an engine to see what it is doing right now.
eng.core.d: NOVA gathers the work of all six engines and explains it to you in plain words, by text or voice, in five languages.
eng.scan.d: Watches prices, volumes and the market regime around the clock and checks every open trade once a minute.
eng.port.d: Spreads the $10,000 demo portfolio across seven sources and shifts the shares when the market regime changes.
eng.log.d: Every forecast is written down before the outcome is known and checked afterwards. Each line is chained to the previous one with a SHA-256 hash, so the past can't be quietly edited.
core.aria: The NOVA radar: coins appear as contacts; only those that pass the filters are locked and pulled to the core
